mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_area_assignment ( id, search_area_id, assigned_account_id, assigned_by_account_id, assigned_at, revoked_at, status, memo, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{searchAreaId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{assignedAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{assignedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{assignedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{status}, #{memo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE search_area_assignment SET status = 'CANCELLED', revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE search_area_id = #{searchAreaId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'

FROM search_area_assignment assignment JOIN search_area area ON area.id = assignment.search_area_id WHERE area.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND assignment.revoked_at IS NULL AND assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY area.id ASC, assignment.assigned_account_id ASC, assignment.assigned_at ASC
